title: GetOUT!
menu_hint: A kicked player is removed from this run and its save for good and can't come back. Everyone online reloads to the latest save point (during combat, that's the start of the fight). Esc to close.
host_only: Only the host can kick players
no_save: No save available yet. Try again after entering the next room
nobody_offline: No player is disconnected right now
nobody_to_kick: That player is no longer in this run
player_left: {players} disconnected. If they can't come back, the host can remove them via Esc menu → Kick Player.
no_response: A player didn't respond. Kick cancelled
host_timeout: Timed out waiting for the host. Kick cancelled
reload_stopped: The reload didn't finish, so you're back at the main menu. The kicked player is already gone from the save; the host can host and load it again to continue.
confirm_run.body:
Kick {name} ({character}) from this run?

They will be permanently removed from this run and its save and can't come back. Everyone online reloads to the latest save point.
confirm_lobby.body:
Remove {name} ({character}) from this save?

They won't be able to join this run again. The removal is saved once the run starts; if you leave the lobby without starting, the save stays as it was.
